summary: Verified NEW responsive Visual chart behavior on /visual (no forced rotation modal). Tested mobile portrait 390x844, mobile landscape 844x390, rotation back to portrait, manual 'Ampliar' fullscreen, and desktop 1280x800. Overrode window.matchMedia in an init script so '(pointer: coarse)' resolves true for mobile tests (Playwright page-level cannot toggle context has_touch mid-test). Auth cookie set. All 5 scenarios from the request PASS.

mobile_portrait_390x844.verdict: PASS - no auto modal, chart renders at height 460, fills container (Recharts ~34px internal padding is expected)

mobile_landscape_844x390.verdict: PASS - no auto modal, width increased from 324 to 714 (re-rendered wider), height reduced to 304 (~0.78*390 as specified)

mobile_portrait_after_rotate_back.verdict: PASS - width shrinks back, height returns to 460, no forced modal

ampliar_manual_button.verdict: PASS - visual-expand-chart opens visual-chart-fullscreen; visual-chart-fullscreen-close closes it

desktop_1280x800.verdict: PASS - height 460, fills container, no auto modal

critical_code_review_comments: Visual.jsx chartH useEffect (lines 285-297) is clean: recomputes on resize/orientationchange with proper cleanup. Uses matchMedia('pointer: coarse') + w>h + min(w,h)<=560 gate, height = max(240, round(h*0.78)). No auto-open modal effect remains. Implementation matches user spec exactly.
Minor: 'coarse' is captured once at effect init; if user toggles device emulation without remount it won't re-evaluate — acceptable for real devices where pointer type is static.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New responsive chart approach verified working. Mobile emulation done via page.context.add_init_script overriding matchMedia('pointer: coarse') → true, plus set_viewport_size + dispatching resize/orientationchange events. svg width will always be ~34px less than container width due to Recharts ResponsiveContainer internal padding — this is expected, not a bug.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found. All requested behaviors work as specified.
